description: Remove one of your own voices for good and free the space it was using. Only works on a voice you cloned or designed yourself: the ready-made library voices cannot be removed. This cannot be undone, so check the name with list_voices (mine_only true) before you call it. Audio you already made with that voice still plays. Free.

voice_id.description: The id of the voice to remove, from list_voices.

name: delete_voice
title: Delete Voice
